description: Baseline frame-diff benchmark stood up from demos/patterns/responsive.py; benchmark passes but repo checks currently fail on existing buffer.py ty diagnostics from main.
Add Buffer-specific fast path in Block.paint using row slice copies instead of per-cell put calls, and fix existing buffer typing issue on main so checks pass.
Streamline Buffer.diff with local bindings and enumerate-based iteration to reduce per-cell overhead in frame diffs.
Add fast equal-buffer short-circuit in Buffer.diff so unchanged frames return immediately before per-cell scanning.
Tried nested row/column iteration in Buffer.diff to avoid modulo/division per changed cell; slightly slower than current best.
Tried compose join_horizontal/join_vertical local caching with direct Block internals; benchmark improved slightly but architecture checks reject accessing private Block._rows outside block.py.
